mapper.select: SELECT UC.*, COALESCE(UCI.IMAGE_ID, 0) AS IMAGE_ID, COALESCE(UCI.IMAGE_URL, 'default_image.jpg') AS IMAGE_URL, COALESCE(UCI.MAIN_IMAGE, 'N') AS MAIN_IMAGE FROM USED_CAR UC LEFT JOIN USED_CAR_IMAGE UCI ON UC.VEHICLE_NO = UCI.VEHICLE_NO ORDER BY UC.VEHICLE_NO ASC, UCI.IMAGE_ID ASC
SELECT UC.*, UCI.IMAGE_ID, UCI.IMAGE_URL, UCI.MAIN_IMAGE FROM USED_CAR UC LEFT JOIN USED_CAR_IMAGE UCI ON UC.VEHICLE_NO = UCI.VEHICLE_NO WHERE UC.VEHICLE_NO = #{vehicleNo} ORDER BY UCI.IMAGE_ID ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE USED_CAR SET VEHICLE_NAME = #{vehicleName}, BRAND = #{brand}, MODEL_YEAR = #{modelYear}, PRICE = #{price}, COLOR = #{color}, FUEL_TYPE = #{fuelType}, TRANSMISSION = #{transmission}, DRIVE_TYPE = #{driveType}, SEATING_CAPACITY = #{seatingCapacity}, CAR_KM = #{carKm} WHERE VEHICLE_NO = #{vehicleNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO USED_CAR_IMAGE (IMAGE_ID, VEHICLE_NO, IMAGE_URL) VALUES (USED_CAR_IMAGE_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{vehicleNo}, #{imageUrl})
mapper.update: UPDATE USED_CAR SET MAIN_IMAGE = NULL WHERE VEHICLE_NO = #{vehicleNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO USED_CAR (VEHICLE_NO, VEHICLE_NAME, DEALER_NO, VEHICLE_TYPE, BRAND, MODEL_YEAR, PRICE, COLOR, DEALER_LOCATION, FUEL_TYPE, TRANSMISSION, DRIVE_TYPE, MAIN_IMAGE, VEHICLE_PLATE, CAR_KM, SEATING_CAPACITY, DESCRIPTION) VALUES (#{vehicleNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{vehicleName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{dealerNo, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{vehicleType, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{brand, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{modelYear, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{price, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{color, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{dealerLocation, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{fuelType, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{transmission, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{driveType, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{mainImage, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{vehiclePlate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{carKm, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{seatingCapacity, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{description, jdbcType=VARCHAR})
